purpose: Test whether original tokenless NativeContextAccumulator can cumulatively learn whether a proposed binary intervention reduces an UPDATED publicly represented candidate set, including 1-vs-3 probes, from ONE witnessed outcome per training query rather than KNOW18 four-world counterfactual labels.
owner_boundary: Independent Yggdrasil knowledge contributor on existing PR1327 only; Unified Causal Intelligence Amalgam Work PR1278 remains sole canonical learner and integration coordinator.

predecessor.know18_identification: 8/12 native and fitted symbolic/tree; 12/12 analytic posterior-aware oracle

source.kind: synthetic binary public source features only
source.data_first_use: NO original-world use; issue #426 remains protected
source.probe_patterns: All 16 four-role public binary patterns, shuffled independently per seed by random.Random(seed*109+31)
source.synthetic_fact_ids: role-independent salted opaque identifiers; no hidden-role bit in public Q/P/Q source
source.role_unobservability: All hidden roles within a source seed have identical public graph and probe options.

native.train_A_candidate_masks: Four 3-role subsets plus 4-role full set; 5*16*2=160 witnessed actions
native.private_role_selection: One hidden role deterministically selected for EACH row by SHA256('know19:v1:'+seed+':'+mask+':'+pattern+':'+action), reduced modulo size of candidate set, never provided as native input.
native.single_witness_feedback: After executing one action in the selected synthetic world, compute remaining candidate count by matching observed binary consequence for each publicly listed candidate. Utility label=1 iff remaining candidate count is STRICTLY SMALLER than previous count, else 0. Never query the other three hidden worlds for that row.
native.fixed_training_budget: Exactly 352 separate synthetic action observations, split into A 160 and B 192 disjoint (context,action) pairs, no cross-world oracle aggregation
native.known_limitation: Analytic hypothesis enumeration and consistency filtering are supplied; labels express only feasibility of information reduction, not expected information gain or experiment optimality.

held.worlds: 3 novel source graphs x 4 hidden roles = 12
held.budget: At most two actions per policy per world
held.policy: Score each unused public probe for each action via cold-restored native .predict on CURRENT candidate mask and that probe's source bits; choose largest positive score, tie by unsigned opaque probe ID then action 0 before 1. After real synthetic outcome, update candidate set with identical public consistency logic for all policies.
held.source_distinctness: Held source IDs, seed graphs and identities differ from training; underlying 4-bit mask/pattern grammar is fully represented during FIT; no claim of unseen grammar.
held.singletons: Evaluate a role-isolated probe family with only 1-vs-3 patterns; after each witnessed action, posterior gets updated. This is a diagnostic, not the original KNOW18 12-world cohort.

controls: Fully trained exact symbolic (mask,pattern,action) lookup on same 352 one-action labels
Fully trained depth-9 conventional binary decision tree or exact 9-input leaf classifier on same 352 labels
Original NativeContextBasis full refit A+B on same labels
Analytic posterior-aware best balanced split oracle with same two-action budget; not counted as learned
Frozen random, passive action0 and source-only no-action negatives with same source and action caps
Old KNOW18 posterior-blind raw-feature policy evaluated as historical reference only; no scored reuse of its held cohort
measurement: Held unique-role identification /12, conditional probe abstention, witnessed action count, posterior sizes and entropy, 1-vs-3 fallback
A predictions for all 160 (context,action) combinations before and after B and after independent checkpoint restore: zero drift required
No source/private role leakage, no oracle cross-world label construction, source-typed negative controls
Full-process CPU wall time, training observations, model bytes, original-model untouched proof and exact-source final Linux/Windows/atlas/source checks
engineering_gate: Native supports every previously observed A input and B input, zero old A prediction drift, cold checkpoint bytes reproduce, positive 1-vs-3 probes never falsely abstain, held role identification at least 10/12; report FAIL otherwise, without retuning.
scientific_gate: NO scientific PASS from this synthetic complete small-grammar protocol. Any claimed gain requires new owner-approved original-world prospective first-use with matched fully trained controls, disjoint unseen operator transfer, retention and whole-process compute. Native-control tie or lower is NO_GO.
stop_rules: One frozen seed/protocol study, no post-result thresholds, seeds or cohort changes, no extra actions, no selecting winning tie rules after scoring. Infrastructure test defects may be corrected transparently without changing scientific hypothesis.
allowed: Research-only code, tests, evidence and existing contributor PR #1327; no new PR, branch owner, canonical learner, checkpoint promotion, source first-use, runner dispatch, scheduler, paid API, merge or deployment.
